newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's first contemporary history museum opens.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's first contemporary history museum opens.

text.p: Portugal's first contemporary history museum, charting the transition from dictatorship to democracy, was inaugurated on Sunday.

The museum, the brainchild of former president Mario Soares, houses a conference centre, art gallery and library, and displays gifts offered to Soares during his two-term presidency from 1986 until March this year.
The museum, in Leiria, central Portugal, contains official archives covering the 1974 armed forces revolt which put an end to more than 40 years of rightwing dictatorship.
